title: Are Paid Dropshipping Courses Worth It in 2026?
summary: Advises beginners against paid dropshipping courses: free resources suffice, income screenshots mislead, watch for urgency tactics, testimonials and upsells.

assertions.quote: A course can't remove that work or guarantee that your store will make money.

verdicts.note: No course changes the product, supplier and acquisition economics that decide profitability.
Automators' dropshipping coaching program claimed the method was risk-free, yet most of its clients did not recoup their investment and the stores were routinely suspended.

assertions.quote: There's already a lot you can learn for free.
somebody teaching you how to make money with dropshipping may be making part of their own income by selling courses
Pressure to buy now or risk missing out is a reason to slow down, not speed up.
A few impressive student stories don't tell you what your own result will be.
a screenshot showing $50,000 in sales doesn't tell you how much money the store owner actually kept
